summary: Composites unlimited image layers in one generated-shader TOP with configurable per-input controls and composite order.

key_params.name: background
key_params.note: Background mode: off, backgroundtop, or constlayer

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Output size source: firstinput, bgtopsize, or outputres

key_params.name: cropunit
key_params.note: Crop units: pixels, fraction, or fractionaspect

key_params.name: scalemode
key_params.note: Scale control mode: off, uniform, xy, or xyuniform

common_gotchas: With Background Off, at least two layer sources are required.
Size controls output resolution, not which layers are composited.
Opacity and bypass can prevent hidden wired inputs from cooking.
Generated shader complexity grows with enabled controls and layer count.
key_concepts: Layer Mix TOP composites unlimited image layers in one node.
Each input has a parameter block, and users choose which per-layer controls appear.
The node generates a single-pass shader based on enabled controls and layer count.
Background can be off, a TOP, or a constant color layer.
Composite order can be front-to-back or back-to-front.
Layer sources can be wired inputs plus TOP references in layer parameter blocks.
